decision.reasoning_trace: After filtering out the numerous non-backpack items in the feed such as camping stoves, pillows, and towels, I narrowed my consideration to products that serve different backpack use-cases: travel (vimapo), fishing (BASSDASH), cooling (SUNLUG), water sports (HEETA), and heavy-duty tactical/hiking use (QT&QY). The QT&QY Military Tactical Backpack (prod_backpacks_057) is the strongest choice due to its high 4.7 rating, large 45L capacity, and durable Molle design, all offered at a very competitive price point compared to specialized bags like the BASSDASH fishing pack.
